integrity_notes: Exact norm and equality characterization proved analytically; supplied standard-library checker corroborates finite rational cases. An earlier equivalent result could exist in inaccessible or unindexed literature; independent validation has not been carried out.
limitations: Real scalar distributional BV on (0,1), unweighted classical Durrmeyer kernel and integrated Lebesgue L1 error. No extension to general Jacobi kernels. The 2000 Zeng–Chen article has not been fully inspected for priority.
title: Exact integrated bounded-variation error of Bernstein–Durrmeyer approximation
